name: Harmony Capital Services Limited
summary: Harmony Capital Services Ltd. specializes in a broad spectrum of financial and investment services. The company's comprehensive offerings encompass financial advisory; structured finance solutions such as lease and hire purchase syndication, bill discounting, and inter-corporate deposits; short-term bridge financing for public or rights issues; feasibility report development; corporate finance advisory, including capital structuring, mergers, acquisitions (M&A), and divestitures; consultancy on public and rights equity offerings; loan syndication with various financial institutions; and general investment banking services. Established on September 19, 1994, the firm maintains its corporate headquarters in Mumbai, India.
